prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for a low-speed head-on collision. Insured reports the other vehicle crossed into their lane on a curve. Both drivers reported as shoulder-injured and transported for evaluation. Police report requested. Liability currently unclear pending statements.

Entry 2: Claimant's counsel has sent a letter of representation. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Requested medical authorizations and prior treatment records for the shoulder complaint. Vehicle inspection scheduled for the damaged bumper and crush area.

Entry 3: Reviewed police report. Responding officer noted both vehicles at low speed with minimal airbag deployment. Witness statement obtained confirming the other driver was over the centerline. Liability leaning toward the other party at this stage.

Entry 4: Received initial demand package from claimant's counsel covering shoulder injury treatment, including physical therapy and an orthopedic consult. Records are being reviewed for consistency with the reported mechanism of impact. Independent medical review requested.

Entry 5: Independent medical review received. Reviewer notes the shoulder findings are consistent with the collision mechanism but recommends additional imaging before final evaluation. Reserve reviewed and adjusted. Follow-up with claimant's counsel set for next week to discuss the records request.
